reviewText: The production quality here is actually insane for a short drama app. Feels like I'm watching a movie on my phone!
Loving the diverse library! Best companion for my daily commute to work, ekdum time pass ho jata hai.
Shows are great but the point system needs some fixing. Sometimes the ads don't load properly and I get stuck.
Interface is very smooth and intuitive. Just wish watching full series didn't require so many points.
High quality content, zero lag on my phone. Subtitles are perfect, keep adding more thrillers please!
